needs_human.note: useRemovableItems keeps a JS-session-global store of keyed removal operations, separate from discoverCache's removal set; resetDiscoverCache does not clear it.; Mark-only drives are now visited by the vision and video-visual startup purges.; ContextMenu `immediate` rows run onClick synchronously within the click event.

useRemovableItems keeps operations in module-level Maps for the whole JS session. Nothing removes them, and resetDiscoverCache does not clear them (its only callers are tests).; ContextMenu's `immediate` flag changes when the handler runs (in the same click rather than the next frame) for the rows that set it.

On the Recommended See all page, useRemovableItems is called without a key, so a removal made by one profile persists in local state across a profile switch that does not remount the page. It is replayed over the next profile's list and hides the same file there.
